clock_contract: Native RankRuntimeClockStamp captures actual QPC before, steady-clock nanoseconds, QPC after, actual positive QueryPerformanceFrequency. Existing native steady latency remains authoritative; no C++/Python epoch assumption.

Actual timed mouse release has input_before immediately before the input queue call and input_after immediately after it; render endpoint bracket follows actual GL draw submission return before JSON inspection. Cancel endpoint retains latest render/actual terminal-resource/cancel-return observation.

Verified native PID/process marker/raw report and external sampler carry matching actual QPC frequency. Every external PrivateUsage sample captures QPC before/after the actual memory API. External scheduling/deadlines use high-resolution perf_counter, with actual clock profile retained.
Cross-thread/process order differences within1 QPC tick are ambiguous. Baseline and interior boundary joins require >1tick separation; never convert ambiguous ordering into eligible samples.

memory_contract.baseline: Latest successful same-native-engine sample with sample.qpc_after+1 < input_before.qpc_before; age <=20ms by exact integer frequency conversion.
memory_contract.interior: Successful sample with sample.qpc_before > input_after.qpc_after+1 and sample.qpc_after+1 < endpoint.qpc_after; overlapping/ambiguous samples excluded and counted.
memory_contract.required: Fresh baseline and at least1 postinput interior sample. Missing/sparse/error/invalid frequency or PID stays explicit missing; no manufactured0 delta or performance pass.
memory_contract.observed_delta: max(actual baseline PrivateUsage, valid interior samples)-actual baseline PrivateUsage; sampled peak only, no allocation census or unsampled-peak assertion.

native_meter: Append JobInfo.reservation_acquired false and peak_reserved_bytes0; at actual lock-protected native ledger charge set acquired true and record actual charged reservation peak, surviving terminal/resource release. No observer-held leases.

Eligible Preview/Apply/running/READY tickets must reflect genuine acquisition/positive actual fixed reservation. Legitimate queued cancellation before acquisition records false/0; a real postcallback admission race may record true/actualpeak. Do not infer acquisition from the declaration or sample maxima.
Single-ticket/baseline-zero trial invariant permits this exact per-ticket native peak as the declared-reservation metric. It is separate from process memory and actual allocated-byte peak.
